strategy.title: No plan: the certificate-pack price is contradicted, and at the sourced price the 140-contractor market cannot carry $6,000
strategy.why: The card records $1,200 while its sourced price fact says $120 - a tenfold contradiction, so neither is established. At the sourced $120, $6,000 needs 50 sales; the market is 140 licensed contractors buying once a year, and at the measured 12% acceptance (12 of 100 contacts on this offer's own sales) asking all 140 yields about 17 sales = ~$2,016. Only the unestablished $1,200 figure (5 sales) would reach the target.

review.reasons: NO_PLAN is the right stance. The only opening's price is contradicted on the card itself (priceCents 120000 = $1,200 vs EVIDENCE price fact $120), and Brain also judges OFFER_AND_PRICE unestablished ('no single price on the card'). Recomputed: at $120 the target needs 50 sales; 140 annual-buying licensed contractors x the measured 12% (12/100 on this offer's own sales) = 16.8 sales = ~$2,016, so MARKET_VOLUME fails at $120; at $1,200 only 5 sales are needed and 16.8 are attainable, so the price fact alone decides the plan. The decisive gap is named correctly, the resolution (Brain researches the parked revenueRange question, then re-plans) is zero-cost, BRAIN-performed and nothing unknown is treated as known (q_price UNKNOWN). Acceptable for the owner to act on.
